title: Financial Statements
description: Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow for a single ticker, per fiscal year or per fiscal quarter (the Period picker), rebuilt from SEC XBRL facts (or Yahoo Finance for listings outside the SEC) via the equity_statement_* views. Highlights show the latest selected period against a year earlier (the fiscal year before, or the same quarter of the fiscal year before); Trends chart the profit, margin, cash, balance-sheet and shareholder-return lines over the selected periods; the statements below are line item x period tables, latest first, in millions of the display currency (Balance sheet and Cash flow statement open with a click on their row). Quarterly shows the latest $quarters quarters of the selected fiscal years. A 10-Q reports cash flow only year to date, and Q4 is never filed on its own, so those quarters are the year to date less the year to date a quarter earlier (Q4: the full year less nine months). Fiscal years are labeled by the calendar year they end in, and quarters by their place in that fiscal year. Money values are converted into the selected currency at each period-end FX rate; share counts are never converted.

links.title: Valuation
links.tooltip: This ticker's price, valuation and TTM fundamentals

list.name: ticker
list.label: Ticker
list.query: SELECT i.symbol FROM instruments i WHERE i.kind = 'equity' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fundamentals f WHERE f.instrument_id = i.id) ORDER BY i.symbol
list.definition: SELECT i.symbol FROM instruments i WHERE i.kind = 'equity' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fundamentals f WHERE f.instrument_id = i.id) ORDER BY i.symbol

list.name: fiscal_year
list.label: Fiscal years
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year::text FROM equity_statement_periods a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') ORDER BY 1 DESC
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year::text FROM equity_statement_periods a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') ORDER BY 1 DESC

list.name: quarters
list.label: Quarters
list.description: How many of the latest quarters of the selected fiscal years the Quarterly view shows. Annual ignores it.

list.name: display_currency
list.label: Currency
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT split_part(unit, '/', 1) AS currency FROM fundamentals WHERE unit ~ '^[A-Z]{3}(/shares)?$' UNION SELECT currency FROM instruments ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT split_part(unit, '/', 1) AS currency FROM fundamentals WHERE unit ~ '^[A-Z]{3}(/shares)?$' UNION SELECT currency FROM instruments ORDER BY 1

list.name: since
list.label: First period shown
list.description: End of the oldest period shown: the latest $quarters quarters of the selected fiscal years, or every selected fiscal year.
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(min(s.period_end), DATE '1900-01-01')::text FROM (SELECT min(p.period_end) AS period_end FROM equity_statement_periods p WHERE p.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND p.freq = '$freq' AND p.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) GROUP BY p.period ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT CASE WHEN '$freq' = 'quarterly' THEN ($quarters)::int END) s
list.definition: SELECT COALESCE(min(s.period_end), DATE '1900-01-01')::text FROM (SELECT min(p.period_end) AS period_end FROM equity_statement_periods p WHERE p.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND p.freq = '$freq' AND p.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) GROUP BY p.period ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT CASE WHEN '$freq' = 'quarterly' THEN ($quarters)::int END) s

list.name: heading
list.label: Highlights heading
list.description: The Highlights row title: the period the tiles show, or why there are no quarterly figures.
list.query: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT 'Highlights — FY' || p.period || ' vs a year earlier, $display_currency' FROM equity_statement_periods p WHERE p.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND p.freq = '$freq' AND p.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) ORDER BY p.period_end DESC LIMIT 1), CASE WHEN '$freq' = 'quarterly' THEN 'No quarterly figures for $ticker: ' || (SELECT CASE WHEN i.taxonomy = 'ifrs-full' THEN 'its SEC filings are annual reports only (Form 20-F / 40-F)' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fundamentals f WHERE f.instrument_id = i.id AND f.period_end - f.period_start BETWEEN 150 AND 210) THEN 'it reports half-yearly, not quarterly' ELSE 'none of its reports covers a quarter' END FROM instruments i WHERE i.symbol = '$ticker') ELSE 'No annual figures for $ticker' END) AS heading
list.definition: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT 'Highlights — FY' || p.period || ' vs a year earlier, $display_currency' FROM equity_statement_periods p WHERE p.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND p.freq = '$freq' AND p.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) ORDER BY p.period_end DESC LIMIT 1), CASE WHEN '$freq' = 'quarterly' THEN 'No quarterly figures for $ticker: ' || (SELECT CASE WHEN i.taxonomy = 'ifrs-full' THEN 'its SEC filings are annual reports only (Form 20-F / 40-F)' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fundamentals f WHERE f.instrument_id = i.id AND f.period_end - f.period_start BETWEEN 150 AND 210) THEN 'it reports half-yearly, not quarterly' ELSE 'none of its reports covers a quarter' END FROM instruments i WHERE i.symbol = '$ticker') ELSE 'No annual figures for $ticker' END) AS heading

panels.title: Revenue
panels.description: Total revenue in the latest selected period (fiscal year or quarter). The arrow is the change from a year earlier: the fiscal year before, or the same quarter of the fiscal year before. There is no arrow when that period wasn't reported or wasn't positive: a change from zero or from a loss isn't a meaningful percentage.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT l.fiscal_year AS fy, l.fiscal_quarter AS fq FROM equity_statement_periods l WHERE l.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND l.freq = '$freq' AND l.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) ORDER BY l.period_end DESC LIMIT 1), a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_periods a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND a.freq = '$freq' AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('income', 'Revenue')) AND a.fiscal_year BETWEEN (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 AND (SELECT fy FROM latest) AND COALESCE(a.fiscal_quarter, 0) = COALESCE((SELECT fq FROM latest), 0)), y AS (SELECT fiscal_year, max(period_end) AS period_end, max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Revenue') AS v FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year), cur AS (SELECT y.period_end, y.v FROM y WHERE y.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) AND y.v IS NOT NULL) SELECT COALESCE(p.period_end, c.period_end - 365)::timestamptz AS "time", CASE WHEN p.v > 0 THEN p.v ELSE 'Infinity'::float8 END AS "Revenue" FROM cur c LEFT JOIN y p ON p.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 UNION ALL SELECT c.period_end::timestamptz, c.v FROM cur c ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT l.fiscal_year AS fy, l.fiscal_quarter AS fq FROM equity_statement_periods l WHERE l.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND l.freq = '$freq' AND l.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) ORDER BY l.period_end DESC LIMIT 1), a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_periods a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND a.freq = '$freq' AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('income', 'Operating income')) AND a.fiscal_year BETWEEN (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 AND (SELECT fy FROM latest) AND COALESCE(a.fiscal_quarter, 0) = COALESCE((SELECT fq FROM latest), 0)), y AS (SELECT fiscal_year, max(period_end) AS period_end, max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Operating income') AS v FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year), cur AS (SELECT y.period_end, y.v FROM y WHERE y.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) AND y.v IS NOT NULL) SELECT COALESCE(p.period_end, c.period_end - 365)::timestamptz AS "time", CASE WHEN p.v > 0 THEN p.v ELSE 'Infinity'::float8 END AS "Op. income" FROM cur c LEFT JOIN y p ON p.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 UNION ALL SELECT c.period_end::timestamptz, c.v FROM cur c ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT l.fiscal_year AS fy, l.fiscal_quarter AS fq FROM equity_statement_periods l WHERE l.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND l.freq = '$freq' AND l.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) ORDER BY l.period_end DESC LIMIT 1), a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_periods a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND a.freq = '$freq' AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('income', 'EPS (diluted)')) AND a.fiscal_year BETWEEN (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 AND (SELECT fy FROM latest) AND COALESCE(a.fiscal_quarter, 0) = COALESCE((SELECT fq FROM latest), 0)), y AS (SELECT fiscal_year, max(period_end) AS period_end, max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'EPS (diluted)') AS v FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year), cur AS (SELECT y.period_end, y.v FROM y WHERE y.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) AND y.v IS NOT NULL) SELECT COALESCE(p.period_end, c.period_end - 365)::timestamptz AS "time", CASE WHEN p.v > 0 THEN p.v ELSE 'Infinity'::float8 END AS "EPS (diluted)" FROM cur c LEFT JOIN y p ON p.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 UNION ALL SELECT c.period_end::timestamptz, c.v FROM cur c ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Free cash flow
panels.description: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditure in the latest selected period (fiscal year or quarter). The arrow is the change from a year earlier: the fiscal year before, or the same quarter of the fiscal year before. There is no arrow when that period wasn't reported or wasn't positive: a change from zero or from a loss isn't a meaningful percentage.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT l.fiscal_year AS fy, l.fiscal_quarter AS fq FROM equity_statement_periods l WHERE l.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND l.freq = '$freq' AND l.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) ORDER BY l.period_end DESC LIMIT 1), a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_periods a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND a.freq = '$freq' AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('cashflow', 'Operating cash flow'), ('cashflow', 'Capital expenditure')) AND a.fiscal_year BETWEEN (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 AND (SELECT fy FROM latest) AND COALESCE(a.fiscal_quarter, 0) = COALESCE((SELECT fq FROM latest), 0)), y AS (SELECT fiscal_year, max(period_end) AS period_end, max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'cashflow' AND line = 'Operating cash flow') - COALESCE(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'cashflow' AND line = 'Capital expenditure'), 0) AS v FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year), cur AS (SELECT y.period_end, y.v FROM y WHERE y.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) AND y.v IS NOT NULL) SELECT COALESCE(p.period_end, c.period_end - 365)::timestamptz AS "time", CASE WHEN p.v > 0 THEN p.v ELSE 'Infinity'::float8 END AS "Free cash flow" FROM cur c LEFT JOIN y p ON p.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 UNION ALL SELECT c.period_end::timestamptz, c.v FROM cur c ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Total equity
panels.description: Shareholders' equity at the end of the latest selected period (fiscal year or quarter). The arrow is the change from a year earlier: the fiscal year before, or the same quarter of the fiscal year before. There is no arrow when that period wasn't reported or wasn't positive: a change from zero or from a loss isn't a meaningful percentage.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT l.fiscal_year AS fy, l.fiscal_quarter AS fq FROM equity_statement_periods l WHERE l.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND l.freq = '$freq' AND l.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) ORDER BY l.period_end DESC LIMIT 1), a AS (SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_periods a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND a.freq = '$freq' AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('balance', 'Total equity')) AND a.fiscal_year BETWEEN (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 AND (SELECT fy FROM latest) AND COALESCE(a.fiscal_quarter, 0) = COALESCE((SELECT fq FROM latest), 0)), y AS (SELECT fiscal_year, max(period_end) AS period_end, max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'balance' AND line = 'Total equity') AS v FROM a GROUP BY fiscal_year), cur AS (SELECT y.period_end, y.v FROM y WHERE y.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) AND y.v IS NOT NULL) SELECT COALESCE(p.period_end, c.period_end - 365)::timestamptz AS "time", CASE WHEN p.v > 0 THEN p.v ELSE 'Infinity'::float8 END AS "Total equity" FROM cur c LEFT JOIN y p ON p.fiscal_year = (SELECT fy FROM latest) - 1 UNION ALL SELECT c.period_end::timestamptz, c.v FROM cur c ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Revenue and profit — $display_currency
panels.description: Revenue, operating income and net income per fiscal year or quarter.

targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT a.period, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_periods a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND a.freq = '$freq' AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('income', 'Revenue'), ('income', 'Operating income'), ('income', 'Net income')) AND a.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) AND a.period_end >= '$since') SELECT period AS "Period", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Revenue') AS "Revenue", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Operating income') AS "Operating income", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Net income') AS "Net income" FROM a GROUP BY period ORDER BY max(period_end)

panels.title: Margins
panels.description: Gross, operating and net margin: each profit line as a share of revenue, per fiscal year or quarter.

targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT a.period, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_periods a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND a.freq = '$freq' AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('income', 'Revenue'), ('income', 'Gross profit'), ('income', 'Operating income'), ('income', 'Net income')) AND a.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) AND a.period_end >= '$since') SELECT period AS "Period", 100.0 * max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Gross profit') / NULLIF(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Revenue'), 0) AS "Gross margin", 100.0 * max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Operating income') / NULLIF(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Revenue'), 0) AS "Operating margin", 100.0 * max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Net income') / NULLIF(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'income' AND line = 'Revenue'), 0) AS "Net margin" FROM a GROUP BY period ORDER BY max(period_end)

panels.title: Cash generation — $display_currency
panels.description: Operating cash flow, capital expenditure (cash spent, shown positive as filed) and free cash flow (the difference), per fiscal year or quarter.

targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT a.period, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_periods a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND a.freq = '$freq' AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('cashflow', 'Operating cash flow'), ('cashflow', 'Capital expenditure')) AND a.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) AND a.period_end >= '$since') SELECT period AS "Period", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'cashflow' AND line = 'Operating cash flow') AS "Operating cash flow", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'cashflow' AND line = 'Capital expenditure') AS "Capital expenditure", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'cashflow' AND line = 'Operating cash flow') - COALESCE(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'cashflow' AND line = 'Capital expenditure'), 0) AS "Free cash flow" FROM a GROUP BY period ORDER BY max(period_end)

panels.title: Liabilities and equity — $display_currency
panels.description: What the company owes and what belongs to shareholders at each fiscal year or quarter end; together they fund the total assets.

targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT a.period, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_periods a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND a.freq = '$freq' AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('balance', 'Total liabilities'), ('balance', 'Total equity')) AND a.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) AND a.period_end >= '$since') SELECT period AS "Period", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'balance' AND line = 'Total liabilities') AS "Total liabilities", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'balance' AND line = 'Total equity') AS "Total equity" FROM a GROUP BY period ORDER BY max(period_end)

panels.title: Cash and debt — $display_currency
panels.description: Cash plus short-term investments against short- plus long-term debt, at each fiscal year or quarter end.

targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT a.period, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_periods a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND a.freq = '$freq' AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('balance', 'Cash & equivalents'), ('balance', 'Short-term investments'), ('balance', 'Short-term debt'), ('balance', 'Long-term debt')) AND a.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) AND a.period_end >= '$since') SELECT period AS "Period", COALESCE(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'balance' AND line = 'Cash & equivalents'), 0) + COALESCE(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'balance' AND line = 'Short-term investments'), 0) AS "Cash & investments", COALESCE(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'balance' AND line = 'Short-term debt'), 0) + COALESCE(max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'balance' AND line = 'Long-term debt'), 0) AS "Debt" FROM a GROUP BY period ORDER BY max(period_end)

panels.title: Returned to shareholders — $display_currency
panels.description: Dividends paid and shares bought back each fiscal year or quarter.

targets.rawSql: WITH a AS (SELECT a.period, a.period_end, a.statement, a.line, a.value * (CASE WHEN a.currency IS NULL OR a.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(a.currency, a.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', a.period_end), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_statement_periods a WHERE a.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND a.freq = '$freq' AND (a.statement, a.line) IN (('cashflow', 'Dividends paid'), ('cashflow', 'Share buybacks')) AND a.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) AND a.period_end >= '$since') SELECT period AS "Period", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'cashflow' AND line = 'Dividends paid') AS "Dividends", max(v) FILTER (WHERE statement = 'cashflow' AND line = 'Share buybacks') AS "Buybacks" FROM a GROUP BY period ORDER BY max(period_end)

panels.title: Income statement — $display_currency millions
panels.description: Annual (10-K / 20-F) or quarterly (10-Q) figures, latest period first, in millions of the display currency at each period-end rate. Q4 is never filed on its own, so it is the full year less the first nine months. Section headers are in blue. A blank cell means the company didn't report that line under a tag we track.

options.pattern: ^(Gross profit|Operating income|Pretax income|Net income|Total .*|.* cash flow|Net change in cash)$

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.line AS line, m.period AS period, m.value * (CASE WHEN m.currency IS NULL OR m.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(m.currency, m.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', m.period_end), 0), 1) END) / 1e6 AS value FROM equity_statement_period_matrix m WHERE m.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND m.freq = '$freq' AND m.statement = 'income' AND m.ord < 500 AND m.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) AND m.period_end >= '$since' ORDER BY m.ord, m.period_end DESC

panels.title: Per share — $display_currency
panels.description: Earnings and dividends per share in the display currency; weighted average share counts in millions (never converted). A derived quarter's EPS is the year to date less the year to date a quarter earlier (Q4: the full year less nine months), so it can differ by a cent from one computed on that quarter's own share count; its share count is time-weighted from the two.

options.pattern: ^(Gross profit|Operating income|Pretax income|Net income|Total .*|.* cash flow|Net change in cash)$

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN m.line LIKE 'Weighted avg shares%' THEN m.line || ', millions' ELSE m.line END AS line, m.period AS period, CASE WHEN m.line LIKE 'Weighted avg shares%' THEN m.value / 1e6 ELSE m.value * (CASE WHEN m.currency IS NULL OR m.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(m.currency, m.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', m.period_end), 0), 1) END) END AS value FROM equity_statement_period_matrix m WHERE m.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND m.freq = '$freq' AND m.statement = 'income' AND m.ord > 500 AND m.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) AND m.period_end >= '$since' ORDER BY m.ord, m.period_end DESC

panels.title: Balance sheet — $display_currency millions
panels.description: Point-in-time balances at each fiscal year or quarter end, latest first, in millions of the display currency at that day's rate. Section headers are in blue.

options.pattern: ^(Gross profit|Operating income|Pretax income|Net income|Total .*|.* cash flow|Net change in cash)$

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.line AS line, m.period AS period, m.value * (CASE WHEN m.currency IS NULL OR m.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(m.currency, m.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', m.period_end), 0), 1) END) / 1e6 AS value FROM equity_statement_period_matrix m WHERE m.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND m.freq = '$freq' AND m.statement = 'balance' AND m.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) AND m.period_end >= '$since' ORDER BY m.ord, m.period_end DESC

panels.title: Cash flow statement — $display_currency millions
panels.description: Cash flows per fiscal year or quarter, latest first, in millions of the display currency. A 10-Q reports cash flow only year to date, so Q2 is the half year less Q1, Q3 nine months less the half year, and Q4 the full year less nine months. Capex, acquisitions, dividends and buybacks are positive outflows, as filed.

options.pattern: ^(Gross profit|Operating income|Pretax income|Net income|Total .*|.* cash flow|Net change in cash)$

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.line AS line, m.period AS period, m.value * (CASE WHEN m.currency IS NULL OR m.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(m.currency, m.period_end) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', m.period_end), 0), 1) END) / 1e6 AS value FROM equity_statement_period_matrix m WHERE m.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND m.freq = '$freq' AND m.statement = 'cashflow' AND m.fiscal_year::text IN ($fiscal_year) AND m.period_end >= '$since' ORDER BY m.ord, m.period_end DESC
